description: Reified 'Destruction' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Location of Destruction Event.description: This field is used to link the documented event of destruction to a location at which it occurred.

Related Event Causal to Destruction Even.description: This field is used to link the documented event of destruction to another event which was the causal reason behind its coming to pass.

Destruction Event Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the documented event of destruction.

Destruction Event Source Reference.description: This field is used to link the documented event of destruction to a textual source which documents the event itself.

Date of Destruction Event.description: This field is used to link the documented event of destruction to an instance of time-span recording the temporal extent of the event.
